newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek brokers' market shares in November- SMEHA.
newsitem.headline: Greek brokers' market shares in November- SMEHA.

text.p: Trading volume at the Athens stock exchange in November dropped to 366.03 billion drachmas from 411.49 billion in October with the bourse closed for four sessions after the Delta Securities scandal.

National Bank subsidiary National Securities led in market share with 52.5 percent of the bourse's trading volume helped by a number of block trades. The exchange's other 64 brokers shared the remaining 47.4 percent.

Cumulative January-to-November turnover reached 3.4 trillion drachmas. January remained the bourse's best month so far this year with turnover hitting 428.8 billion drachmas. May was the worst with 209 billion.

(*) Delta Securities was charged with fraud after defaulting for 2.6 billion drachmas with the clearing house in November. Its assets and accounts were frozen. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
